item.title: Often Receive error Request Failed: 408 in Agent Mode

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue identified by VS Code Team member as probable bug

labels.name: chat-agent
labels.description: Issue with the Agent mode in Chat

item.body:
I use copilot pro and often receive error in agent mode like this:
```
Sorry, your request failed. Please try again. Request id: fe7c7a35-76a8-49da-8b0c-4a9dfb281253

Reason: Request Failed: 408 {"error":{"message":"Timed out reading request body. Try again, or use a smaller request size.","code":"user_request_timeout"}}
```

This is not good for agent coding if the limit is very small or if there is no system to split the context when it exceeds the length limit. It should follow the example of how Cline Bot and Blackbox AI handle context length and chat.
